‍


One of the most valuable assets in venture capital isn't capital itself. It's access.


Mat Sherman has spent years building a network that helps ambitious founders get in front of the right investors.


His own entrepreneurial journey helped shape that mission. Today, he's putting that network to work through MatCap.


MatCap operates differently from a traditional venture capital firm. It takes small equity stakes in startups in exchange for curated investor introductions and strategic fundraising guidance.


The model allows MatCap to support more companies without the capital constraints of a traditional venture fund.


Mat works with founders he would personally invest in, connecting them with investors he believes would make valuable partners.


He's also built a system that adapts to investor responses, helping him determine when to expand outreach and when to refine a founder's fundraising narrative.


It's a combination of technology, human judgment, and years of relationship-building.


Mat has spent years building relationships across the venture ecosystem. With MatCap, he's putting those relationships to work for founders he genuinely believes in, with a business model that ties his success to theirs.
